pre_mortem: Monday, both unders lost, because the Sutton 4.0 yards per target was the fluke step 5 warns about and the 71 air yards were the tell: LA's 2 explosives on 68 throws were a two-game mirage, Nix was not blitzed on most dropbacks, and two intermediate catches turned 9 targets into 45 yards. Dobbins lost the under because no spread was saved and DEN was the team that led, so 9 carries and 36 yards became 15 carries against a run defense that had already allowed 5 gains of 10+, and one of those was his. A missing injury — a LA run-fitter out, or Coleman/Harvey inactive so Dobbins absorbed the 10 and 3 carries — would have done it and this pack could not show it. That counter is why Sutton is flagged rather than sized, but it is not stronger than the LA explosive-choke plus Nix blitz read, so the leg stays.
slip_story: One story: LA's defense is the better unit in this pack (30% blitz into Nix -0.55 EPA vs blitz, 2 explosives on 68 throws, 4.43 YPC) and DEN's skill lines sit above the roles. Sutton recyds under 36.5 and Dobbins rushrecyds under 57.5 win together in that suppression script and if DEN trails (Dobbins carries fall, Sutton still pressed). Do not add Adams over 71.5, Waddle over 59.5, Ferguson over 50.5, or a total over — those need the shootout flip that kills Sutton. Do not add Harvey rushrecyds under 42.5 without an inactive check; he is the screen back (4 targets, -22 air yards) whose receiving rises in the same blitz script, and a Dobbins scratch flips him.
